d:
From the eerie Nevada State Prison and Winchester Mystery House to the Haunted Museum, the Ghost Adventures crew takes on some of the most chilling locations. With unexplained activity, unsettling encounters and mysteries buried in each location's past, these investigations put the team's courage to the test. Catch some of the most unforgettable moments from Season 12!
Watch Ghost Adventures, S12, Episodes 10, 11, 13, 2, 5, 4 & 1 on Discovery Channel India.
